q006.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished, mathematically accurate Traditional Chinese junior-high geometry explanation infographic on white background, wide landscape 3 panels, forest green original geometry, orange auxiliary constructions, crisp thin lines, readable labels, no decoration. Title:「旋轉與畢氏定理」. All points must follow these Cartesian coordinates with y increasing UP: A=(0,0), B=(0,-3.4269), C=(3.4269,-3.4269), D=(3.4269,0), P=(0.8378,-0.5462), Q=(0.5462,0.8378). Thus A is square top left, B bottom left, C bottom right, D top right; P is INSIDE near A, Q is OUTSIDE ABOVE AD. Panel 1「① 逆時針旋轉90°」: show full square ABCD, P inside, triangle PAB in green and rotated triangle QAD in orange, a CCW rotation arrow around A sending B to D, P to Q. Label AP=1, AQ=1, PB=3, QD=3; all line endpoints precise. Panel 2「② 找出直角」: omit full square to enlarge triangle APD plus external Q; connect AP,AQ,PQ,PD,QD. P→A lies upper left, P→Q upper left but to the RIGHT of P→A, and P→D upper right, so ray PQ is BETWEEN PA and PD. Label PQ=√2, PD=√7, QD=3; a clear right-angle square at P BETWEEN PQ and PD, and 45° arc BETWEEN PA and PQ, yielding angle APD=135°. Bottom equation「2＋7＝9 → ∠QPD＝90°」. Panel 3「③ 延長PD，作高AH」: show A,P,D and H ONLY. H=P−(1/√14)(D−P)≈(0.1459,-0.6922); H is on line DP extended BEYOND P AWAY from D. H,P,D collinear in this order. Draw AH perpendicular HP, rightangle at H, AP=1, angle APH=45°, AH=PH=√2/2, PD=√7. Note DH=√7＋√2/2. Bottom result「AD²＝AH²＋DH²＝8＋√14」. Avoid misplaced right-angle marks, avoid Q inside square, avoid H between P and D, avoid claiming AD length equals area. Keep each panel geometrically internally consistent. No extra points or unsupported conditions.

q105.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a mathematically accurate Traditional Chinese geometry construction infographic, wide 3 panels, white background, crisp forest-green main outline, thin gray dashed auxiliary lines, orange final answer line. A rectangular notch PQRS is removed from its TOP edge, located toward the LEFT (small notch center left of big center). P notch top-left, Q notch bottom-left, R notch bottom-right, S notch top-right. The remaining polygon boundary in order is A-P-Q-R-S-D-C-B-A. All corners exactly right angles. Choose big rectangle width 6 height 3, notch extends from horizontal 0.6 to 2.6 from left and depth 0.8 from top, so distinct centers O₁ and O₂. These numbers are CONSTRUCTION GUIDANCE ONLY, DO NOT show any numerical dimensions or coordinates in the image. PANEL1 heading「① 找大矩形中心」: show notched polygon, restore missing top segment PS with thin dashed line (A-P-S-D collinear), draw dashed diagonals AC and BD crossing at O₁. Label O₁ at their intersection. PANEL2 heading「② 找凹矩形中心」: same notched polygon, restore missing top PS dashed, draw only dashed small rectangle diagonals PR and QS crossing at O₂. Label O₂. PANEL3 heading「③ 連接兩個中心」: same notched polygon with O₁ and O₂ clearly dots, draw a single straight orange line L passing THROUGH BOTH O₁ and O₂ and extended beyond whole shape on both ends.
